purpose: Audit of existing REA evidence for reconstruction coverage; no new native analysis or runtime session was performed.

confidence_legend.observed: An exact resource text, object, metadata value or source-code gap is present. This does not establish runtime visibility.
confidence_legend.inferred: An analyst interpretation links resources to a likely UI role or behavior; verification is pending.
confidence_legend.unknown: Evidence was not captured, was partial, or cannot answer the question.

global_limits: No application executable was decompiled/disassembled in this pass; resource-root identity is not an executable digest.
Resource counts do not measure feature completion or UI parity.
IB frames are archived values, not resolved runtime geometry; SwiftUI/programmatic views may be missing.
Selectors are archived target-action connections, not proof of implemented behavior.
Large graphs and most asset catalogs are partial; zero recovered controls does not imply absence of UI.
No accounts, private user libraries, network-service state, permissions or native device behavior were examined.
Installed application bundle versions differ; app version strings do not by themselves identify the OS build.

prioritized_shell_discrepancies.current: Main renders a transparent desktop menu bar unless Reduce Transparency is enabled, and a black full-screen bar; no explicit background preference exists.
prioritized_shell_discrepancies.recommendation: Add a persisted Show menu bar background preference and connect it to actual menu-bar rendering. Verify material/opacity and interaction with accessibility modes in a live comparison.
unknown: Native default value and exact background material are not established.

prioritized_shell_discrepancies.current: Only 24-hour format and a combined showClock toggle are exposed; day/date are fixed in the format and seconds are absent.
prioritized_shell_discrepancies.recommendation: Implement clock options for date, weekday, seconds and AM/PM with live clock output; retain clock visibility independently. Analog/announcement controls should require real functionality or be explicitly unavailable.
unknown: Static strings do not prove control order, exact option groups, locale formatting or defaults.

prioritized_shell_discrepancies.current: The Settings explanation describes only full-screen auto-hide, without a user-selectable mode.
prioritized_shell_discrepancies.recommendation: Expose an auto-hide mode connected to the shell state machine, after verifying the native option grouping. Test reveal behavior both on desktop and in full screen.
unknown: Always/In Full Screen Only/On Desktop Only/Never exist in the same localization; exact grouping and defaults are inferred rather than observed.

prioritized_shell_discrepancies.current: Dock size, magnification, auto-hide, indicators and launch animation are wired; position, minimization choice and title-bar double-click behavior are not exposed in the Dock page.
prioritized_shell_discrepancies.recommendation: Prioritize position and real minimize animation selection, then title-bar action, using the resource-backed labels. Preserve explicit user fullscreen requirements when choosing defaults.
unknown: Native layout, animation curves and default title-bar action remain unmeasured.

prioritized_shell_discrepancies.current: Liquid Glass choices honor Reduce Transparency. Scrollbars currently offer When scrolling and Always only; Increase Contrast and sidebar icon sizing are not exposed.
prioritized_shell_discrepancies.recommendation: Add only controls that change actual rendering; native labels also describe Increase Contrast incompatibility and automatic scrollbar mode.
unknown: Native automatic detection and accessibility rendering are not established by strings.
